skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — crop to 9:16, add captions, and trim the intro silence — and get Instagram...

latestVersion.changelog:
Instagram Video Editor Web 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches a web-based AI video editor designed for Instagram creators.
- Supports uploading MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB and automates editing tasks such as cropping, captioning, and trimming.
- Instant cloud processing and export — get Instagram-ready videos in about 30–60 seconds.
- Automatic setup with token management and session handling.
- Export jobs processed on cloud GPUs, with progress feedback and error handling.
- No desktop installation required; everything runs in the browser.
